requirements.text: The game must be named "Tower Tiles".
requirements.check: The game window title displays "Tower Tiles".
requirements.quote: Create a one-screen tower defense game called "Tower Tiles"

requirements.text: The game must be played on a 12 by 8 grid.
requirements.check: The game displays a visible grid with 12 columns and 8 rows.
requirements.quote: on a 12 by 8 grid

requirements.text: A fixed winding path of brown tiles runs from the left edge to the right edge.
requirements.check: A continuous path of brown tiles is visible, starting at the left edge and ending at the right edge.
requirements.quote: A fixed winding path of brown tiles runs from the left edge to the right edge

requirements.text: All tiles not part of the path are green grass.
requirements.check: All grid tiles not part of the brown path are colored green.
requirements.quote: all other tiles are green grass

requirements.text: Purple blobs walk along the path in waves.
requirements.check: Purple blob entities appear at the start of the path and move along it.
requirements.quote: Purple blobs walk along the path in waves

requirements.text: Each blob that reaches the right edge removes one of 10 lives.
requirements.check: When a blob reaches the right edge, the 'Lives' counter decreases by 1.
requirements.quote: each blob that reaches the right edge removes one of 10 lives

requirements.text: The player moves a white selection square over the grid with the arrow keys.
requirements.check: Pressing arrow keys moves a white square cursor across the grid.
requirements.quote: The player moves a white selection square over the grid with the arrow keys

requirements.text: Pressing Space builds a tower on the selected grass tile, costing 50 coins.
requirements.check: When the selection square is on a grass tile, pressing Space places a tower, and the 'Coins' counter decreases by 50.
requirements.quote: presses Space to build a tower on the selected grass tile, costing 50 coins

requirements.text: Towers automatically shoot the nearest blob within 2 tiles, one shot per second.
requirements.check: Towers fire projectiles at blobs within a 2-tile radius at a rate of one per second.
requirements.quote: Towers automatically shoot the nearest blob within 2 tiles, one shot per second

requirements.text: Each blob needs 3 hits to be defeated.
requirements.check: A blob disappears after being hit by 3 tower projectiles.
requirements.quote: each blob needs 3 hits

requirements.text: Defeating a blob gives 20 coins.
requirements.check: When a blob is defeated, the 'Coins' counter increases by 20.
requirements.quote: Defeating a blob gives 20 coins

requirements.text: The player starts with 150 coins.
requirements.check: At the start of the game, the 'Coins' counter shows 150.
requirements.quote: The player starts with 150 coins

requirements.text: Press N to send the next wave early.
requirements.check: Pressing 'N' causes the next wave of blobs to start immediately.
requirements.quote: Press N to send the next wave early

requirements.text: Show coins, lives and wave number at the top.
requirements.check: The current coin count, lives remaining, and current wave number are displayed at the top of the screen.
requirements.quote: Show coins, lives and wave number at the top

requirements.text: Surviving 5 waves shows WIN and freezes the game.
requirements.check: After the 5th wave is cleared, 'WIN' is displayed, and game elements stop moving.
requirements.quote: Surviving 5 waves shows WIN; losing all lives shows GAME OVER; both freeze the game.

requirements.text: Losing all lives shows GAME OVER and freezes the game.
requirements.check: When lives reach 0, 'GAME OVER' is displayed, and game elements stop moving.
requirements.quote: Surviving 5 waves shows WIN; losing all lives shows GAME OVER; both freeze the game.

requirements.text: Press R to restart the game.
requirements.check: Pressing 'R' resets the game to its initial state (coins, lives, wave, no towers).
requirements.quote: Press R to restart

requirements.text: Press Escape to quit the game.
requirements.check: Pressing 'Escape' closes the game window.
requirements.quote: and Escape to quit.

requirements.text: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: MOVE UP, MOVE DOWN, MOVE LEFT, MOVE RIGHT, BUILD, NEXT WAVE, RESTART and QUIT.
requirements.check: The console shows 'MOVE UP', 'MOVE DOWN', 'MOVE LEFT', 'MOVE RIGHT', 'BUILD', 'NEXT WAVE', 'RESTART', or 'QUIT' when the corresponding action occurs.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: MOVE UP, MOVE DOWN, MOVE LEFT, MOVE RIGHT, BUILD, NEXT WAVE, RESTART and QUIT

requirements.text: Print WIN or GAME OVER to the console when the game ends.
requirements.check: The console shows 'WIN' or 'GAME OVER' when the game reaches an end state.
requirements.quote: and print WIN or GAME OVER when the game ends.

files.purpose: Main game logic, including game loop, event handling, rendering, and game state management.

assets.strategy_rationale: The spec explicitly states 'Use plain coloured shapes only; no images or sounds.', so all assets will be drawn procedurally in code.

architecture.test_input_example: Press RIGHT 5 times, DOWN 2 times, SPACE. Press N. Wait for blobs to appear and towers to shoot. Press R. Press ESCAPE.
